title: What Each Digit in a Number Actually Means
description: A column breakdown of place value — what the hundreds, tens, and ones digits in a number like 352 really represent.
narration_lines: What does each digit in 352 actually mean?
Let's look at the number 352, column by column.
Hundreds, tens, and ones — 3 hundreds is 300, 5 tens is 50, and 2 ones is 2.
Add those up and you get 352. Each place is worth 10 times the next.

params.footnote: each position is worth 10 times the one to its right
